param_input_item.param_description: a uint8 vector of 32 bytes or 64 hexadecimal characters: your private key.
a uint8 vector of 32 bytes or 64 hexadecimal characters: the other party public key.

param_output_item.param_description: a character vector: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (32 bytes).

description.p: crypto.x25519.shared computes the Diffie-Hellman shared secret (RFC 7748) from your secret key and a peer public key. Both parties obtain the same value.
Do not use the raw shared secret as an encryption key: hash it first, for example with crypto.blake2b(shared, [], 32).

example_item.example_item_description: both peers agree on the same secret
